infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pav Dental needs camera access for video consultations and capturing intraoral triage photos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Pav Dental needs microphone access for live audio during video dental consultations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pav Dental needs photo library access so you can attach dental photos and clinical documents.
